job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
The Client & Role
Our client is an established New Zealand organisation looking for an experienced Network Engineer to join their internal IT team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on, solving technical challenges and getting involved in network projects. You'll be working across a large, multi-site environment, supporting existing infrastructure while contributing to upgrades, improvements and new deployments.

The role will initially involve a mix of project delivery and BAU support, with the opportunity to become increasingly project-focused over time.

Working closely with the Network Architect and wider IT team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work while continuing to develop your technical skills.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Support, configure and maintain network infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Deliver network upgrades, migrations and infrastructure improvement projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues across routing, switching, wireless and WAN environments.
  • Support network security, firewalls and SD-WAN connectivity.
  • Work closely with internal teams, external vendors and service providers.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, configurations and technical procedures.
  • Assist with network monitoring, performance improvements and incident resolution.
  • Participate in an on-call roster and occasional site visits.
Key Requirements:
  • Around 5+ years' experience in network engineering, although strong intermediate candidates will also be considered.
  • Solid networking fundamentals across routing, switching, VLANs, LAN/WAN and wireless technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with networking technologies such as MikroTik, Aruba, Juniper, UniFi or Fortinet. 
  • Good understanding of network security, firewalls and connectivity.
  • Experience delivering network projects, upgrades or migrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of technical tasks.
  • Good communication skills and a positive, proactive attitude.
If you're a hands-on Network Engineer looking for a role where you can get involved in meaningful projects, develop your skills and make a real impact, please apply today or reach out to jen@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Finance Manager - Project Delivery
job.description:
The Business

This large-scale, fast-paced New Zealand business plays a key role in keeping the country connected, delivering telecommunications infrastructure, network construction, ICT solutions and essential services nationwide.
With a substantial national footprint and a diverse portfolio of complex infrastructure and delivery projects, the business is looking for an experienced Finance Manager to lead the financial performance of its Project Delivery division.

The Opportunity

Reporting to a senior finance leader and managing a team of four, this is a hands-on, commercially focused role with responsibility for a $100m plus portfolio spanning major telecommunications and infrastructure projects, including mobile network builds, fibre infrastructure and network integration.
Working closely with the Chief Delivery Officer and Programme Leads, you'll play a key role in driving project profitability, improving financial visibility and addressing cost overruns across the portfolio.
This is a broad role combining technical project accounting, end-to-end financial management, commercial business partnering and people leadership. You'll need to be equally comfortable getting into the detail of project costs and WIP as you are presenting financial insights and challenging operational stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Lead end-to-end financial management of the Delivery portfolio, including month-end, P&L reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Oversee complex project accounting, WIP, contract costing, milestone-based revenue recognition (IFRS 15) and progress claims.
  • Monitor project profitability, cost-to-complete, margins and cost overruns, identifying risks and opportunities to improve performance.
  • Partner closely with senior operational leaders and Programme Leads, providing meaningful financial insights to support commercial decisions.
  • Improve financial reporting, forecasting accuracy, processes and controls to drive greater visibility and accountability.
  • Provide financial oversight of contract pricing, tenders, renewals and commercial opportunities.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of four, maintaining high standards of delivery while building capability and engagement.
About You

You'll be an experienced Finance Manager, Commercial Finance Manager or Senior Finance Business Partner with a strong background in project-based construction, telecommunications, engineering or infrastructure environments.
Importantly, you'll understand the financial complexities of delivering large-scale projects and contracts, including revenue recognition, WIP, direct costs, project margins and forecasting.

We're looking for someone who brings:
  • Strong project accounting and contract costing experience, ideally within construction, civil infrastructure, engineering or telecommunications.
  • Sound technical knowledge of IFRS 15, WIP, milestone-based revenue recognition and project profitability.
  • Proven end-to-end financial management experience, including P&L ownership, reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the confidence to partner with, influence and challenge senior operational stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the ability to develop a team while maintaining accountability and delivery standards.
  • A hands-on, proactive approach, with the ability to move between financial detail and broader commercial strategy.
  • CA/CPA qualification or equivalent, with strong systems and financial modelling capability. Experience with Dynamics 365, Workbench or similar project management systems would be advantageous.
What's on Offer?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant project delivery portfolio within a well-established New Zealand business, with genuine scope to influence commercial performance, strengthen financial processes and develop a capable finance team.
You'll work closely with senior business leaders on complex, high-value infrastructure projects where your financial expertise and commercial input will make a tangible difference.

An attractive salary package of $150,000–$155,000 plus additional benefits, including medical and life insurance and staff concessions, is on offer.

To find out more, apply now or contact Mel Monty for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Network Design & Operations Engineer
job.description:
We're partnering with a well-established telecommunications infrastructure organisation to find a Network Design & Operations Engineer to join their Hamilton-based team.

This is an opportunity to work across critical fibre and telecommunications infrastructure, combining hands-on engineering with network design, operational improvements and technical leadership.

For the right person, there's also a clear opportunity to develop into a Principal Engineer position.

The opportunity:

You'll play an important role in the ongoing design, operation and improvement of a complex telecommunications network, working closely with technical specialists and senior leadership.

This isn't a purely operational support role or a high-level architecture position. We're looking for someone who enjoys getting into the technical detail, solving challenging problems and helping shape the future of the network.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Designing, implementing and improving network infrastructure across core, transport and access environments.
  • Supporting network operations, troubleshooting complex issues and providing senior technical escalation.
  • Working across routing, switching, fibre access and telecommunications technologies.
  • Supporting network upgrades, capacity planning, performance optimisation and resilience.
  • Producing technical designs, documentation and engineering standards.
  • Identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  • Providing technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
  • Working closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver reliable network services.
What we're looking for

You'll ideally bring a strong background in telecommunications, service provider or carrier-grade networking, with the ability to contribute technically from day one.

We're particularly interested in people with:
  • Strong hands-on network engineering experience across design, implementation and operations.
  • Experience with IP networking technologies including MPLS, BGP, OSPF and routing/switching.
  • Exposure to fibre access networks, GPON/xPON or telecommunications transport infrastructure.
  • Experience working with technologies such as VXLAN/EVPN, DWDM/CWDM or BNG/BRAS would be advantageous.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience resolving complex network issues.
  • Experience producing technical documentation and contributing to network design decisions.
  • The ability to work independently, collaborate with others and provide technical guidance.
Experience with Nokia, Juniper, Cisco or similar telecommunications networking platforms would be beneficial.

You don't need to tick every box. We're open to speaking with experienced engineers who have a strong foundation in carrier networking and are keen to continue developing their technical expertise.

What's on offer?
  • Career progression: Opportunity to grow into a Principal Engineer role.
  • Technical ownership: Genuine involvement in network design and engineering decisions.
  • Interesting technology: Work across complex fibre and telecommunications infrastructure.
  • Long-term opportunity: Join an established organisation with ongoing investment in its network. 
If you're an experienced Network Engineer looking for a role where you can combine hands-on technical work with network design and longer-term career progression, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV, or contact Caitlyn Spedding at Alexander James for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Client & Role 

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to join a growing consultancy specialising in data engineering, analytics and cloud solutions. Working across a range of clients and industries, this is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys developing people while still being involved in the technical side of things.

You'll be leading a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and overseeing the design and delivery of modern data solutions. Strong hands-on experience across Databricks, SQL and Python is important, with exposure to Snowflake highly regarded. You'll also help shape engineering standards, review technical designs and support the team's continued development.

Ideally, you'll come from a consulting background and enjoy working directly with clients, understanding their needs and seeing projects through from start to finish. We're looking for someone who is confident, approachable and commercially minded, with a natural ability to build relationships and manage expectations.

Key Responsibilities: 
  • Leading, mentoring and developing a team of Data and Analytics Engineers.
  • Overseeing the design and delivery of scalable data platforms, pipelines and lakehouse solutions.
  • Providing technical guidance and remaining hands-on where required.
  • Taking ownership of project delivery, including technical quality, timelines and stakeholder expectations.
  • Establishing engineering best practices across CI/CD, testing, data quality and documentation.
  • Working closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Supporting the growth and development of the engineering capability.
Key Requirements: 
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Workflows.
  • Advanced SQL, Python, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modelling and lakehouse solutions.
  • Well versed with Azure, AWS or GCP, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and testing. Snowflake or Fabric beneficial.
  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing engineers while remaining technically involved.
  • Proven experience overseeing projects, managing stakeholders and ensuring successful delivery.
Ideally, you'll bring 10+ years in data engineering or analytics, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or engineering management role. 

Looking for a new challenge before the end of the year? This could be a great opportunity to bring your expertise to a growing New Zealand organisation and make a real impact. Please apply today!

job.title: Contracts Manager
job.description:
Newly created Contracts Manager role created for some to step into a growing, multi-disciplinary construction business, taking ownership of significant projects and helping shape the way they are delivered.

With an established reputation across specialist construction services, the business is expanding its capability to deliver larger projects across New Zealand and the wider Pacific.

To support this growth they are now looking for a commercially astute, delivery-focused Contracts Manager who can take projects from handover through to completion, while helping build the systems, processes and project management capability needed.

The opportunity

As the Contracts Manager, you will take end-to-end responsibility for designated projects, overseeing delivery, commercial performance, programme, risk and client relationships.

You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, lead multidisciplinary project teams and work closely with senior leadership, rather than getting caught up in layers of corporate bureaucracy.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Taking ownership of projects from post-award handover through mobilisation, delivery, practical completion and final commercial close-out.
  • Driving project financial performance, including margins, forecasting, cash flow, variations and claims.
  • Leading project managers, quantity surveyors, site teams, subcontractors and suppliers to deliver safe, high-quality outcomes.
  • Managing construction programmes, procurement, contractual obligations and project risks.
  • Building strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders, resolving issues proactively and protecting commercial outcomes.
  • Developing project controls, processes and delivery capability to support larger, more complex projects in the future.
  • Feeding practical delivery insights back into estimating and tendering to continually improve project performance.
The culture

This is a business with a genuine village feel. It's a more personal, hands-on environment than you might find in a large tier-one contractor, with significantly less hierarchy and more direct access to decision-makers.

You'll be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to contribute ideas and able to see the impact of your work. Rather than being another name in a large corporate structure, you'll be a key part of the business's continued growth.

For someone who enjoys accountability, collaboration and having a real voice in how things operate, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

We are looking for:

You'll bring strong contractor-side construction experience, with a track record of delivering complex projects and taking ownership of both operational and commercial outcomes.

Ideally, you'll have:
  • Experience across civil, concrete, structures or multidisciplinary construction projects.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including project forecasting, cost control, claims, variations and contract administration.
  • A solid understanding of construction programming, procurement and subcontractor management.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and coordinating operational and commercial stakeholders.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to make decisions and manage risk.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build lasting relationships with clients, subcontractors and internal teams.
Main contractor delivery experience, along with exposure to regional, remote or Pacific projects, would be advantageous.
  
Why consider this role?
  • A newly created position with the opportunity to shape how projects are delivered.
  • Genuine ownership of project delivery, commercial performance and outcomes.
  • Direct access to senior leadership and less corporate hierarchy.
  • A collaborative, family-oriented culture where people support one another.
  • The chance to help build capability as the business moves into larger and more complex projects.
  • A permanent Auckland-based opportunity offering scope to make a lasting impact.
For more information contact tom@alexanderjames.co.nz
